title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Anthropic Rolls Out Projects in Claude Code with Parallel Cloud Execution: Anthropic launches Projects in Claude Code on desktop and web, enabling single conversations to automatically split complex work into parallel cloud threads that run asynchronously even after closing the laptop.

Ex-ChatGPT Co-Inventors Launch Jev Frontier Decision Model: @typesafeai releases Jev, a high-speed frontier decision AI model trained via Reinforcement Learning from Composable Decisions (RLCD) that delivers 20-200x faster decision execution and sub-millisecond structured outputs.

Z.ai Open Sources GLM-5.3-Flash Inference Infrastructure: Z.ai details how GLM-5.3 optimized its own serving infrastructure for GLM-5.3-Flash, tripling production throughput in under two weeks using dense local correctness tests and microbenchmarks.

Taelin Releases Bend 2 Parallel GPU Programming Language: Taelin unveils Bend 2, a new GPU programming language compiling to HVM2 that eliminates AI mistakes via formal proof-checking and scales high-level code across thousands of GPU cores.

items.title: @claudeai: Anthropic Rolls Out Projects in Claude Code with Parallel Cloud Execution
items.body: Anthropic introduces Projects in Claude Code across web and desktop, allowing a single prompt conversation to break tasks into parallel cloud worker threads that continue running contextually in the background.

items.title: @TheMattBerman: Jev Frontier AI Model Achieves 200x Speedup via Parallel RLCD
items.body: Developers showcase Jev, a stealth frontier decision model built via Reinforcement Learning from Composable Decisions (RLCD) that analyzed 724 live ads across 37 brands in 40 seconds for 9 cents of tokens.

items.title: @Zai_org: Z.ai Shares GLM-5.3-Flash Serving Infrastructure Optimization
items.body: Z.ai details how GLM-5.3 self-optimized the inference stack for GLM-5.3-Flash, tripling end-to-end throughput in under two weeks via local correctness traces and microbenchmarks.

items.title: @VictorTaelin: Bend 2 GPU Programming Language Integrates Proof Checking
items.body: Taelin launches Bend 2, a high-level programming language compiling to HVM2 GPU kernels that uses formal proof checking to eliminate AI code mistakes across thousands of cores.

items.title: @JinaAI_: Jina AI Releases jina-ocr-v1 Speculative Visual Document Parser
items.body: Jina AI introduces jina-ocr-v1, a 3.4B parameter (570M active) vision parser with built-in speculative decoding for converting complex PDFs, scans, and tables into markdown.

items.title: @jiang_kev: PolarBrowser Raises $5.7M Seed for Autonomous AI Web Browser
items.body: MIT and YC alum team raises $5.7M for PolarBrowser, an AI-native web browser engineered to automate sales, recruiting, and operations tasks in 30 seconds.

items.title: @N01ennn: SpaceXAI Engineers Stream 9-Hour Company Build with Grok Bot Fleet
items.body: SpaceXAI engineers detail their 9-hour live stream building an entire startup using 20+ Grok Bot agents structured under Chief of Staff and PM agents.

items.title: @KeithMcCullough: 24-Year Hedge Fund Process Blueprint Released
items.body: Hedgeye founder Keith McCullough publishes a free 52-page guide titled 'Master the Market', detailing quantitative risk management and macro positioning processes.

items.title: @ronmortgageguy: Pierre Poilievre Outlines Canadian Economic Reforms
items.body: Canadian political podcast discusses federal economic strategy, tax reductions, housing affordability initiatives, and potential airport privatization debates.

items.title: @Alex8282019: US Housing Market & Local Economic Friction Observed
items.body: Homeowners and administrators report local economic friction in top school districts, with extended home listing durations and administrative workhour reductions.

items.title: @GUST_EN: Atelier Karia Physical Pre-Orders Open for 2027 Launch
items.body: GUST officially launches physical pre-orders for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories across PS5, Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

items.title: @METALSLUG_EN: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection Announced for 30th Anniversary
items.body: SNK and Metal Slug reveal Metal Slug Ultimate Collection featuring 9 classic arcade titles plus the unreleased location test version for the 30th anniversary.

items.title: @espn: Colorado and Coach Prime Win on Georgia Tech Blocked Field Goal
items.body: Colorado Buffaloes secure a thriller victory after blocking Georgia Tech's potential game-winning field goal in the closing seconds.
